labels: AI by-eye labels (WP3 part 2), test video: scoring only
rule: as for the dev clip: event frame = first frame whose centre (960, 540) shows the other side of the surface (exit: sky / horizon / the back in air, even through droplets or a water film; entry: the water column, including froth); crossing = frames in between (foam / water sheet / lens rising through the thin water layer over the back). time_s = frame / fps.

events.note: the camera rides just under the surface from about f39490 (Snell window with surface texture, the back's brown reflection around it: underwater). From f39538 the half-out phase (boundary rule 2026-11-20): smooth circular waterline rim across the dome, crisp clouds, brownish band at the centre, a teal water region still at the left, ripple rings; f39554-f39557 the lens rises through the last water layer (streaks). f39558 first frame with the above-water scene at the centre (foam line / sky / wet back through a water film). Exit frame uncertain by about 3 frames, crossing start by about 3 frames. f39565-f39571 a wave washes over the lens with sky visible through it: air (boundary rule). Droplets only from f39572.

f39634 last frame with sky / horizon at the centre (splash rising on the left); f39635-f39637 foam / water sheet over the lens; f39638 first frame with underwater froth and water column at the centre. Air phase f39558-f39634 about 2.5 s.

same pattern as the first exit: just under the surface f40020-f40047 (Snell window with surface texture, brown reflection: underwater); from f40048 the half-out phase (smooth circular rim, clouds, brownish band at the centre, teal water region at the lower left up to f40074); f40075-f40076 lens rising through the last water layer; f40077 foam line and sky at the centre. f40078-f40092 water washes over the lens with sky visible through it: air (boundary rule); droplets only from f40093. A splash rises ahead on the water at f40116-f40124 (blow or another animal? unsure). Uncertain by about 2 frames.

f40156 last frame with the above-water scene at the centre (wave / back with whitewater, sky top right); f40157 a water sheet over the whole lens; f40158 first frame with the water column (teal, bubble jet) at the centre. Air phase f40077-f40156 about 2.6 s. After the entry a pale knobby pectoral flipper with a dark body above it is at the left (f40164-f40187): another whale or the tagged whale's own flipper, unsure.
